response.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), average_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_cost FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(l.expense_count) AS expense_count, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_cost) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN average_spend AS a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_cost
